acceptance: Reconciliation re-authorizes through the Rust boundary, refuses other sources, principals and revoked or expired sessions, records every attempt, and moves out of Unknown only on a receipt that proves commit or non-commit.

positive.fixture: fenced-receipt disconnect before commit reconciles to Failed and a receipt after commit to Verified; the exclusion is released

negative.fixture: identical values from another actor, stale reads, unchanged or non-monotonic versions, a receipt for another request, an executor overclaiming, revoked or expired sessions, changed environment

versions.schema: IR 1.1.0 unchanged; journal metadata optional keys added

security_and_source_permissions: Reconciliation uses the same Rust authorization boundary as execution and never reads the source first.
known_limitations: Unproven outcomes stay Unknown; receipts are the only closing evidence
